liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (3 reviews): Listener describes the performance of this song as very hot; Listener describes the performance of this song as ridiculous [19][23][25]
- **Stranger** (2 reviews): Listener describes the performance as a rip-snorting version of the song; Garcia smokes through the jam in a great version of the song [14][19]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Garcia's guitar erupted from speakers like an alien creature during the first lead [18]
- **Althea** (1 review): Listener describes the performance of this song as amazing [18]
- **Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Brent's solo is characterized as sounding like a guitar and a cat in heat [14]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Listener identifies this transition into I Know You Rider as their personal favorite [16]
- **Samson And Delilah** (1 review): Jerry rips notes to shreds in an absolutely smokin performance [20]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): The song receives an extra-special vocal treatment, though it could have gone longer [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-03-09.mtx.seamons.101168.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 187 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd81-03-09.glassberg.wise.7473.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 187 min; rated 4.67/5 by 66 [4]. Said about its sound: Recording captures the beautiful space within the garden and Jerry's wailing throughout; Sound is described as excelling for the venue, with great power coming through; Audience buzzing is audible throughout the show, making it an absolute keeper [14][19][20][21]
- **gd1981-03-09.nak700.glassberg.motb.82373.sbeok.flac24**: source not stated; 21 songs; 186 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [5]
- **gd1981-03-09.nak700.rolfe.miller.95179.flac24**: source not stated; 21 songs; 181 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [7]
- **gd1981-03-09.sbd.miller.74220.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 173 min; rated 4.76/5 by 17 [9]
- **gd81-03-09.sbd.clugston.4953.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 170 min; rated 3.87/5 by 15 [11]. Said about its sound: Crowd noise is audible without losing the band's sound, conveying the venue's magic [17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer brought a Black Sabbath fan and a Disco Diva to the show [17]
- Jerry barely moved during the entire show while ripping leads on every song [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-03-09.mtx.seamons.101168.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC24 & FLAC16>AIFF>Final Cut>WAV>FLAC16) [1]. Also: SBD source is Nak 700 to Cassette Master to Dat to CD, taped by Barry Glassberg; Transfers and mastering were performed by Charlie Miller using a VX Pocket 440 [1]
- **gd81-03-09.glassberg.wise.7473.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording: Nak CM700's [4]
- **gd1981-03-09.nak700.glassberg.motb.82373.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by A. Egert and C. Ladner; source: Nakamichi CM700's > Sony TC-D5M > MAC [5]. Also: Mastering used Adobe Audition 2.0 with Waves Z-Noise and Izotope plugins [5]
- **gd1981-03-09.nak700.rolfe.miller.95179.flac24**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/Maxell UDXL-IIS) [7]. Also: Steve Rolfe lent his masters for the Beat It On Down The Line FOB source [7]
- **gd1981-03-09.sbd.miller.74220.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat (44.1k) [9]. Also: Patches were applied for Estimated Prophet, Stella Blue, and U.S. Blues [9]
- **gd81-03-09.sbd.clugston.4953.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [11]

## Art and photos

- Poster by arizjones.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead, Madison Square Garden, New York, NY, 3-09-1981 (SBD)](https://arizjones.blogspot.com/2015/06/grateful-dead-madison-square-gareden.html) [27]
- Fan art by jpc.de: [Grateful Dead: Madison Square Garden 3/9/81 (180g) (Limited Edition) (5 LPs)](https://www.jpc.de/jpcng/poprock/detail/-/art/grateful-dead-madison-square-garden-81-82-83/hnum/11705714) [28]
- Poster by John Rottet Grateful Dead: [1981-03-09 Madison Square Garden, New York, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1981-03-09-madison-square-garden-new-york-ny-usa/) [29]
